step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard architecture illustrates United Airlines' centralized AWS backup solution across Child and Central accounts. 1. In a Child account, IAM role events trigger CloudTrail, which sends events to EventBridge in the Central account. 2. EventBridge triggers AWS Step Functions in Central, which orchestrates backup vault and policy setup back in the Child account's AWS Backup. 3. IAM connects directly to AWS Backup. 4. ServiceNow (SNow) connects to CloudFormation in the Child account to provision just-in-time access roles for restores. 5. QuickSight is present in the Central account for operational reporting dashboards.
